Our 30-Day Transition Journey

A smooth transition is essential to protecting day-to-day operations, tenant experience and property performance. At ADURE we follow a structured 30-day handover process designed to bring every part of the property under management in a clear, controlled manner.

From reviewing documents and existing arrangements to inspecting the asset, communicating with tenants and setting up reporting, each stage prepares the property for a seamless move into full management.

Week 1

Review

Understand the asset, review documentation and identify existing requirements.

Week 2

Inspect

Assess the property, operations and resident needs.

Week 3

Takeover

Bring operations, communications and reporting into alignment.

Week 4

Manage

Move forward with clear oversight and a focus on long-term value.
